history.q: Can I offer a discount on off-plan units?
history.answer: Never lead with price. Ask what the client needs first, then show the payment plan before any discount.

history.q: What if the buyer wants to see the developer’s track record?
history.answer: Share two delivered projects with handover dates, then walk through the escrow protection.
